exact_statement: Refinement of A012 v7 with a paid partial-profile operation: for normalized finite laws P,Q with Q positive on supp(P), a fixed cell partition with profiles p,q, 0<t<1 and r=(1-t)q+t p, define R(x)=r_j Q(x)/q_j on cell j. This preserves every complete inherited conditional law and reference-only atom. Charging FULL c=D(R||Q)=D(r||q) gives exact net rebate CE(P,Q)-CE(P,R)-c=((1-t)/t)[D(r||q)+D(q||r)]>=0. At t=1/2 the rebate is symmetric KL. Under actual physical queries with marginal reference, signed draw tau=K Inf_i-gamma, K=4+2/ln2, admits this handoff iff weighted(tau-rebate) fits the SAME previously unused original stock after every old booking/conversion debit. For the saved v7 six-bit target, after s0 then s1 on all branches, q_empty=21/32, actual p_empty=(1/16,1,9/16,1), expected remaining I=1/2. Half-profile transport retains BOTH full terminal KLs and old5/(4ln2), charges the full new conversion, and leaves >1/128 bit; all real t in[1/2,5/8] leave >1/256 bit by exact endpoints and convexity. No variance reserve is renewed. Complete-reference shape is stable under physical marginalization; budget admission is conditional, not automatic. The old v7 admitted-function grammar is unchanged, so no opaque hidden core is newly admitted. After all three shared queries expected I=1/4 and K/4-5/(4ln2)=1-3/(4ln2)<-1/16 bit even with zero terminal/reference costs. Thus arbitrary-query closure with flat old booking against remaining influence is impossible under this policy; a genuine original-source liability transfer is still required. Full FEI remains OPEN.
